title: The gain balances two errors
summary: Complete the square, find the gain, test an assumption.

steps.title: Mix two uncertain estimates
steps.caption: The scalar model has prior error variance p = 1 and measurement error variance r = 4, with zero cross-covariance. Gain k weights the measurement.

steps.title: Compare the resulting variance
steps.caption: Variance is (1-k)²p + k²r. For these inputs, a half-and-half blend has variance 1.25; k = 0.2 gives 0.8. All plotted gains share one scale.

steps.title: Complete the square
steps.caption: SymPy verifies variance = pr/(p+r) + (p+r)(k-p/(p+r))². Since p+r is positive, the square exposes the unique optimal gain for this objective.

steps.title: Test the missing cross term
steps.caption: If the cross-covariance is 1/2, an extra 2k(1-k)c term changes the optimum to 1/8. The independent-error formula cannot certify the correlated model.
